blocks.text: Ek massless (jis ka mass na ho) chhari ke sire par laga mass m lein (Fig. 3.15). Pivot O par bearing mein friction nahi, aur system horizontal plane (chapta hissa) mein hai. Mass par chhari ke perpendicular force F lagti hai, jo mass ko yun accelerate karti hai:
Is force se mass O ke gird ghoomne lagta hai. Tangential acceleration a_T aur angular acceleration α ka relation (rishta):

blocks.alt: Patla daira, centre (beech ka point) par pivot O aur O se dashed horizontal (zameen ke barabar leta hua) line. Grey chhari O se daire par mass m ki gend tak, dashed line se angle (kona) θ oopar. Chhari ke saath naap ki line us ki lambai r dikhati hai, aur gend par teer F chhari se seedha right angle (90°) banata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.15: Force F axis O ke gird torque paida karti hai aur mass m ko pivot ke gird angular acceleration alpha deti hai (kitab ki Figure 3.15 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Turning effect (ghumane wala asar) torque τ paida karta hai, is liye rotation (ghoomna) ki equation torque mein likhna behtar hai. Dono taraf r se multiply karein:
Yeh Newton ke doosre law F = ma ki rotational shakal (ghoomne wali shakal) hai.

Yahan F ki jagah τ, a ki jagah α aur m ki jagah mr² aa gaya. mr² ko moment of inertia kehte hain aur I se likhte hain. Rotational motion (apne axis par ghoomna) mein moment of inertia wahi kaam karta hai jo linear motion (seedhi line mein chalna) mein mass karta hai: yeh rotation mein change ko rokne (inertia) ka naap hai. Moment of inertia sirf mass m par nahi balke faasle r² par bhi depend karta hai.

Zyada tar rigid bodies mein mass axis se different (alag alag) faaslon par different amount mein hota hai, yani mass distribution (mass ka phailao) uniform (ek jaisa) nahi. Fig. 3.16(a) mein object chhote chhote tukron m₁, m₂, .... se bana hai jo axis O se faaslon r₁, r₂, .... par hain. Agar object angular acceleration α se ghoome to m₁ par torque:
aur isi tarah baqi tukron par.

blocks.alt: Ek hi irregular rigid body (sakht cheez jo shakal na badle) ke do views, neela rang, chhoti square masses m₁, m₂, m₃ aur m₄ dashed lines r₁, r₂, r₃ aur r₄ se axis O se juri hain. (a) mein m₂, O se guzarti dashed horizontal line par hai. (b) mein poora object O ke gird ghoom chuka hai, aur kinare se bahar dashed line horizontal se angle θ banati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.16: Bare rigid body ka har chhota tukra pivot ke gird ek jaisi angular acceleration rakhta hai (kitab ki Figure 3.16 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Object ghooma to har tukra m₁ se m₄ apne apne faasle r₁ se r₄ par usi angle θ se ghooma; (a) se (b) tak sab ki angular displacement, angular velocity aur angular acceleration barabar hai. Farq sirf faaslon ka hai, is liye kul torque = (m₁r₁² + m₂r₂² + ...)α = Iα.

blocks.text: Chaaron ka mass m barabar ho to bhi moment of inertia alag hai, kyunke mass axis se different faaslon par phaila hai. Hoop (chhalla) ka saara mass kinare (faasla r) par hai, is liye I = mr² sab se zyada. Disc mein mass beech mein bhi hai, to I = ½mr²; sphere mein aur zyada mass axis ke qareeb hai, to I = ⅖mr². Patli rod (lambai L, beech se axis): I = (1/12)mL².

blocks.prompt: 60 cm diameter ke 200 kg sphere ka moment of inertia kya hai? Linear motion mein mass inertia ka naap hai; rotation mein is ki jagah kya hai, aur yeh sirf mass par kyun depend nahi karta?
blocks.explanation: Radius r = 30 cm = 0.30 m. I = ⅖mr² = ⅖ × 200 kg × (0.30 m)² = 7.2 kg m². (Agar diameter 0.60 m ko ghalti se radius le lein to 28.8 kg m² aata hai.) Rotation mein mass ki jagah moment of inertia I = Σmᵢrᵢ² hai, jo batata hai ke object angular acceleration ko kitna rokta hai (τ = Iα). Yeh mass ke saath saath is baat par bhi depend karta hai ke mass axis se kitna door phaila hai, kyunke har tukra mᵢrᵢ² deta hai.

items: Chhari par mass: F = mrα; dono taraf r se multiply: τ = mr²α, jo F = ma ki rotational shakal hai (m ki jagah I = mr²).
Rigid body: τ = (Σmᵢrᵢ²)α = Iα, I = Σmᵢrᵢ²; I mass aur us ki axis se doori dono par depend karta hai.
Hoop I = mr², disc ½mr², sphere ⅖mr², patli rod (1/12)mL².
